 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Relative azimuth (degrees) :
  
    Relative azimuth convention : 
        180 degrees <-> Satellite and Sun in the same half-plane
          0 degree  <-> Satellite and Sun in opposite half-planes with respect to the zenith direction
  
    Simulated relative azimuth (degrees) :
        for VZA < 0 (sign convention):   270.00000000000000     
        for VZA > 0 (sign convention):   90.000000000000000     
  
 Columns parameters :
   LEVEL   :  Level I of the profile
                TOA is level 0
 		      0+ (over surface) is level           26
 		      0- (under surface) is level          27
   Z       :  Altitude or depth (meters)
   VZA     :  Viewing Zenith Angle (deg)
   SCA_ANG :  Scattering angle (deg)
   I, Q, U :  Stokes parameters at level Z (in sr-1)
              normalized to the extraterrestrial solar irradiance (PI * L(z) / Esun)
   POL_ANG :  Polarization angle (deg)
   POL_RATE:  Degree of polarization (%)
   LPOL    :  Polarized intensity at level Z (in sr-1)
              normalized to the extraterrestrial solar irradiance (PI * Lpol(z) / Esun)
